dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_0.tex: Every port has a rack of postcards, and every time I swear I'll send one home before the tide turns.
dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_1.tex: Bring me ten good ones. A captain's word carries weight at the market, and I'll spend mine on you.
dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_3.tex: Books are cargo for the mind. Postcards are proof you remembered the shore.
dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_4.tex: All right. Ten postcards, carefully chosen.
dialogue.captain_quest_1.root.line_5.tex: Good. Bring me a stack worth sending, and the market gate will open easier for you.
dialogue.dlg_intro_tilde.cool.line_0.tex: I understand, I'll drop by later.
dialogue.dlg_intro_tilde.root.line_0.tex: I heard you've opened a shop…
dialogue.dlg_quest_01.root.line_0.text: I need one book. Can you help?
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_0.text: So this is that new shop everyone's talking about. And here I thought the rumors were exaggerating.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_1.text: Rumors rarely exaggerate for the better. Come in — it's quiet right now.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_2.text: Quiet is good. I can't stand picking books in a crowd.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_3.text: Then you're in luck. What are you after — something specific, or just browsing?
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_4.text: Just browsing, mostly. A good book usually finds me on its own.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_5.text: There are plenty of them here, so its chances are pretty good.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_6.text: I like that confidence in a shopkeeper. Usually it's in short supply.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_7.text: I just know my shelves. If you need anything, don't hesitate to ask.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_8.text: Deal. And… I'm glad you've finally opened.
dialogue.dlg_tilde_meet.root.line_9.text: Thank you. Make yourself at home — this is a place you can linger in.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_0.text: One more thing about this shop before I get properly out of your way.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_1.text: Watch what people ask for. A good shopkeeper reads the town as carefully as any book.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_2.text: So I should sell whatever they keep reaching for?
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_3.text: Exactly. Crime, drama, classics, fantasy - every shelf teaches you something about the street outside.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_4.text: That sounds like more work than retirement advice usually contains.
dialogue.eddy_quest_1.root.line_5.text: Retired people have time to notice patterns. Sell a few, and you'll start seeing them too.
dialogue.eddy1.agree.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.agree.line_0.text: That's why I came here - I'm looking for my calling.
dialogue.eddy1.disagree.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.disagree.line_0.text: I know exactly what I want.
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_0.text: I always dreamed of having a bookshop.
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.dream.line_1.text: It's a good thing, finding your calling in life.
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_0.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.job.line_1.text: That's true. But you know what they say? If you find your calling, you'll never work a day in your life!
dialogue.eddy1.mid.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.mid.line_0.text: Though you look far too young for that. Everything can still change many times over.
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_0.text: Well, looks like it's time for you to open the little shop. Customers have already noticed you and are heading this way.
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.outro.line_1.text: I'll pick out something to read this evening myself, so retirement doesn't get too dull.
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_0.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_0.text: There we go, the last signature is in place. This place is yours now.
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_1.speaker: Eddy
dialogue.eddy1.root.line_1.text: And a well-earned retirement is waiting for me. For 40 years, I made children happy with sweets right here in this very spot.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_0.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_0.text: Hi. I left a letter for you - a proper one, with all the important bits underlined.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_1.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_1.text: When someone asks for facts, give them something exact. It saves everyone so much confusion.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_2.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.millie1.root.line_2.text: You make it sound like the wrong book can start an argument.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_3.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_3.text: It can. Last week someone asked me about stars and left with a romance. Beautiful, but useless for stars.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_4.speaker: Morgan
dialogue.millie1.root.line_4.text: Factual books for factual questions. I can do that.
dialogue.millie1.root.line_5.speaker: Millie
dialogue.millie1.root.line_5.text: Find five good matches and I'll know this shop is safe for curious people.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_0.text: The children keep asking me for stories, and I never know which ones will truly catch them.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_1.text: Help five of them find the right book, and I'll make sure the port hears your name.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_2.text: What kind of stories do they ask for?
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_3.text: Brave ones, funny ones, impossible ones. Mostly books that make the walk home feel shorter.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_4.text: So I should listen for children asking, not just any light story.
dialogue.tara_quest_1.root.line_5.text: Yes. Match five young readers with books they'll carry around all week.
Back already? Good. Before you run off, let me show you something useful.
Every shopkeeper keeps a journal: tasks, people you've met, routes, and the next thing worth doing.
Tap it when you're ready. It's right there on your screen.
So the journal is where I check who needs what?
That's right. It keeps your quests in one place and reminds you what each person asked for.
Open it whenever the shop feels noisy. A calm list can save a busy day.
